confidence_notes: Food prices use Sintra and Portugal price aggregates. Hostel rates vary seasonally; the private-room estimate doubles a per-person average. Cocktail price is estimated from local beer prices, and wine uses local glass-price guidance. Hotel anchors are holistic estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Portugal-wide price data provides context where Sintra-specific aggregates are limited; hotel estimates reflect Sintra's tourist demand near Lisbon.
